figures.Fig17.7: Menstrual cycle (PDF page 80). Original figure archived as c12-bio-ch17-fig-17-7-menstrual-cycle (drawn for this lesson after the printed figure; not the textbook's picture). The printed figure shows the phase name 'Secretary phase' and the end of the menstrual phase at day 4; drawn as 'Secretory phase' with the menstrual phase line at day 5, as the book's text gives days 1-5 (correct).

findings: The book says LH is released because FSH falls as estrogen rises; most accounts attribute the LH surge to the high pre-ovulatory estrogen level (positive feedback). The lesson notes this and the original diagram shows the standard pattern, flagged.

'Copus luteum' is printed for corpus luteum, and 'the gonadotropins and FSH begin to rise' repeats FSH. The For Information boxes on menopause and hCG are carried. The chapter's exercises (PDF 81-82) are not part of the lesson body.
